_comment: Every external claim the prose relies on: the job posts the book is calibrated against, the series it belongs to, and the protocol and vendor documentation behind the Google Cloud sections. tools/check_drift.py verifies that each source is still reachable (and, for job posts, still published) and reminds when a source is older than review_after_days. The prose is never edited by automation.
